jobs.name: Nightly Research
jobs.task: Run the nightly research cron per the homa-track-story-coach skill. Pick the most stale domain across benchmarks/ and practice/, research it, update the file, update any child profiles if an intervention is proposed, regenerate the vault, and post a recap to the research channel.

jobs.name: Weekly Scoring
jobs.task: Run the weekly scoring cron per the homa-track-story-coach skill. For each child: recompute age, decay stale confidence, score all subdomains, identify gaps/strengths/unknowns, draft next week's focus and measurement protocol, snapshot the profile, regenerate the vault, and post a summary.

jobs.name: Homa Journal Prompt
jobs.task: Run the daily journal prompt per the homa-capture-journal skill. Check if the previous question was answered. If yes, post a new question to the journal channel. If no, skip silently.

jobs.name: Email Triage Hourly
jobs.task: Run the hourly email triage per the homa-capture-email-triage skill. Scan inbox for important unanswered emails, dedupe against prior pings, DM the parent with triage cards for anything that needs attention.

jobs.name: Homa Dashboard Daily
jobs.task: Regenerate and deploy the dashboard. Run: python3 scripts/regenerate_vault.py (which runs all generators including the dashboard). Then run python3 scripts/post_dashboard_slack.py to post the daily summary to the main channel.

jobs.name: Vault Audit Weekly
jobs.task: Run the weekly vault audit per the homa-system-vault-audit skill. Check for staleness, drift, missing capture, empty folders, and cross-link rot. Post an audit digest.

jobs.name: Reaction Retro Weekly
jobs.task: Run the weekly reaction retro per the homa-capture-feedback skill. Read the last 7 days of feedback.jsonl, cluster patterns, and post a digest.

jobs.name: Ambient Learning
jobs.task: Run the ambient learning loop per the homa-track-story-coach skill. Read recent chat history from monitored channels, extract signals about children (observations, corrections, milestones, preferences), update profiles, journal the findings. Silent — no chat output.

jobs.name: Daily Janitor
jobs.task: Run the daily janitor: python3 scripts/janitor.py --live. Rotates logs, truncates cron run files, ages stale memory files, runs health checks. Post summary only if warnings found.
